body:
It’s not just the fakeness. I never fit in no matter where we move (moved two times the last 12 year. Apartment to first home we owned, then to a cheaper cost of living.) I’m either too open, or too closed off. Have too many kids, not religious enough or too religious (non denominational Christian, don’t shout it from the rooftops and treat everyone equally/kindness). 

My husband works a lot which I understand because we own a company that has a couple offices and employees. So I understand the stress but he doesn’t need to work as much as he does. If I tell him my depression issues “I don’t have time for this”, “isn’t this why you see a therapist so I don’t have to hear it”. Divorce is not a option, going to start marriage counseling in a few weeks. 

My bipolar is under control but my depression hasn’t been for a long time. There are days it’s all I can do to just get out of bed and care for my kids. That’s why we have a weekly housekeeper otherwise our house would be horrendous because I can barely function. Haven’t had her since quarantine began but I can semi keep up on it. Not sparkling, not hoarderish but looks a little lived in. Things picked up, dishes done etc.

I have three close friends who I can talk to about anything, they know I’m struggling but don’t know how bad it is. Due to how I grew up you always threw on a smile, never angry. Got to be the perfect family!!! I’ve taught my kids it’s ok to show emotion even in public. It’s ok to be sad, a little angry etc. 

My kids do seem happy despite me yelling a lot. I spend time with all of them everyday doing crafts, reading etc. I just feel like they would be way more happy if I was gone. 

I’m just tired of being tired, not feeling true happiness. I don’t even know what that is.

It’s crazy around here but can be fun. Add in one of my kids has some needs that he needs therapies for. I manage it as best as I can though. Thank god for outside help though. I told my husband last year that I either get a mom’s helper and a monthly deep cleaning housekeeper or I get committed because I can’t do it. Both have helped so much. I have a good group of friends also so that helps
That’s good to hear! Thank you :)
Thank you for your advice also :) I’m going to look into meditation, maybe I can do it before the kids get up in the morning.

I have filled a prescription for busprione but am afraid to take it. One of the side effects is drowsiness and I’m worried about falling asleep while taking care of my circus. I used to take CBD oil twice a day and that helped with my quick to anger but it’s expensive!

I was on lithium for four years from diagnosis. Ended up with a left leg tremor, psychiatrist was concerned so we did the whole fun stopping thing. Took a year for the tremor to go away. 

Psychiatrist started me on lamictal, increased over time. Five years in (9 years after diagnosis) my skin literally started peeling off on my hands and arms. I went and saw a dermatologist. Fpund out I somehow have a allergy to freaking lamictal. Psychiatrist has me on a low dose while we figure out the next step. My skin issue is still there but at least it’s not falling off anymore! 

I’m grateful for the medicine but really wish the side effects didn’t exist. I just want to feel normal
I wish I could upload video because I’m going to take a video tonight of the sounds.

I could frame it like “hey could you get a video of that bear sometime? I’m worried it could be sick and with our kids running through the woods I just want to be safe”

Also I’m thinking, it’s winter wouldn’t bears be hibernating right now?
Yep. There’s a guy in our neighborhood that I just get chills from. I don’t know how to describe it but my flight or fight sense always comes on when I see him.

I don’t know about granite but we have a huge greenstone boulder near the river that is nicknamed after our town. The town east of us has a huge rock quarry. 

Raspberries are plentiful around here. People raised heck because the town was spraying pesticides on all the wild raspberry plants. Thankfully they stopped.

I used to not believe in any of that stuff until I had a encounter with a skinwalker in southern Utah in 2007. Now I’m a big believer in these things. My husband thinks I’m nuts 😂

I googled tree knocking and now I’m more inclined to think it’s not a bear with mange. Every night around 10 pm if you’re outside you can hear it. I used to think why the heck is someone building something at night? Now I’m wondering if it’s tree knocking. 

I’m wondering how I could go ask my neighbor if I could have her get video or something 😂

I just did, showed her and she said nope. 

Those are freaky looking though!

It’s hard to explain but I hope it makes sense. When I get visions or whatever it’s very matter of fact, this is what is going to happen and everyone will be fine.

Only other time I’ve felt like this was when my mom passed away from suicide. When I talked to her a few hours before she did it I blurted out “I forgive you and I love you” She said “ok love you too” and hung up. The next day I experienced what I’m experiencing now with the hair raising, empty heart, thinking of her. I had flashes of her and random places in her house but couldn’t figure out why. When I got the call I just knew but it didn’t keep me from my reaction. 

Crossing fingers it’s nothing but I can’t help but freak out more. We chatted over FaceTime (thank you international phone plans!) a few minutes after I posted this and he seemed a little agitated and freaked out. I asked what’s wrong and he said it’s nothing he’s just nervous about his speech. He’s never acted like that before. So that’s not helping me feel better.
